text: "10: I like to be totally helpless and at my partner's disposal, physically unable to resist what they do."

speaker: Beth
text: "12: I enjoy playing or acting like a pet animal (dog, cat, pony, etc.)"

speaker: Beth
text: "14: There is no reason why ■■■ would have to happen in private spaces, isolated from the outside world."

speaker: Beth
text: "15: I find the romantic aspect in a relationship much more important than the ■■■■■■ or kinky aspects."

text: That’s a 6. Look, the machinery has to run—that’s the baseline. But if you don't love the engineer, the engine is just cold metal. speaker: Beth
text: "16: I would like to serve in a formal setting with explicit slave training, prescribed physical positions and rituals, etc."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 2. I don't need a manual for how to sit or stand. I’ve got my own rhythm, and I prefer improvising to the road conditions over memorizing a rulebook. If you want me to serve, just tell me what needs fixing. I'll handle the rest.

speaker: Beth
text: "17: Assuming I was single, I would like to join an existing couple's or polygroup's relationship for ■■■■■■ and/or emotional purposes."

text: That’s a 2. I’m a one-radio kind of dispatcher. Juggling multiple signals like that? It’s a recipe for crossed lines and missed stops. I prefer one clear connection where I know exactly who I’m talking to. Keep the channel private.

speaker: Beth
text: "18: Being physically restricted during ■■■/BDSM (with clothes, attributes, rope, chains, etc.) is arousing."

text: That’s a 4. I’m sturdy, I can take the strain. Being held down or tied up? Sure, if the rope is good and the knots are honest. It’s a nice break from running the floor, letting someone else handle the rigging. I just need to know the line isn't going to snap.

speaker: Beth
text: "19: I enjoy feeling like a prey hunted by a predator."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 2. I’m the one watching the tracks, not running from them. The whole "hunted" vibe? It implies I'm not paying attention to the route, and I always pay attention. I'd rather be the one doing the chasing, keeping the target in my sights until we're home.

speaker: Beth
text: "20: I don't have any sort of specific fetish or non-standard ■■■■■■ turn-on."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. "Standard" is just the default setting on the router, and who runs with the default? I’ve got very specific wiring under the hood. I like what I like—knots, schedules, control—and I’m not about to apologize for having a custom setup.

speaker: Beth
text: "21: Being part of a group of slaves that serves one Master/Mistress, sounds like a life that would really suit me."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. I don't do barns. I run the server room, not the stable. I need to be the one with the clipboard, making sure the job gets done right. Serving in a herd? That’s just noise. I’m a solo act, or maybe a tight duo, but I’m definitely not one of the herd.

speaker: Beth
text: "22: I would like to be completely tied up during ■■■/BDSM."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 3. Being completely trussed up is a safety hazard. What if I need to brace myself or catch a fall? I like some restriction, sure—keeps me honest—but total immobilization? That’s just asking for a dropped wrench. I need enough range of motion to participate in the work.

speaker: Beth
text: "23: I enjoy being kept as a pet: in a cage, eating out of a bowl, being petted/caressed, etc."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. I’m not putting anyone in the kennel, and I’m sure as hell not climbing in one myself. I’ve got thumbs and a ladder for a reason. I want a partner who can look me in the eye and hand me a wrench, not someone who expects me to lick their hand. Keep the bowls for the actual dogs.

speaker: Beth
text: "24: I love seeing the fear in my partner's eyes when they know I'm going to inflict pain on them."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. Fear means the system is failing, that trust has broken down somewhere. If I’m the one inflicting pain, I want it to be a calibration, not a crash. We're in this together, not a victim and a villain. I don't want terror; I want the solid, earned knowledge that we can take it.

speaker: Beth
text: "25: I like to be ■■■■■■■■ degraded and humiliated by my partners sometimes."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. I don’t do degradation. If I’m handing over the reins, I want it to be because I trust the driver, not because I’m being run into the dirt. Being told I’m garbage? That doesn’t sharpen the blade; it just ruins the edge. I’m here to build things up, not tear them down.

speaker: Beth
text: "27: I would like to be nothing but a 24/7 ■■■ slave (i.e. not having any human interaction outside of ■■■ and BDSM)."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. A system that runs at max output 24/7 burns out in a week. I need my off-hours. I need the tram rides, the silence, the coffee. Being nothing but a machine for someone else’s use? That’s a broken timetable. I’ve got a life outside the depot, and I’m keeping it.

speaker: Beth
text: "28: Treating my partner with little or no respect during ■■■/BDSM arouses me."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 1. Respect is the safety rail. You take that off, and we’re not playing, we’re just waiting for the accident. If I’m taking charge or giving it up, the baseline is that we value each other. Cruelty doesn't turn my gears; it just jams them.

speaker: Beth
text: "29: I like being forced into submission, much more than submitting spontaneously."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 4. Look, I can respect a good hard override when the schedule’s tight and someone needs to take the wheel. It’s efficient. But I’ve also got no problem pulling over and handing over the keys if the driver is right. Forced is fine, but voluntary? That’s just good maintenance.

speaker: Beth
text: "30: I would like it when my partner is completely tied up during ■■■/BDSM."

speaker: Cora
text: Oh, that’s a 7. That’s beautiful efficiency. If my partner is completely tied up, they can’t interfere with the repairs. speaker: Beth
text: "31: I have plenty of ■■■■■■ fantasies that I would like to try out, more than most of my kinky peers."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 4. I’ve got ideas, don’t get me wrong—configurations I want to test, scenarios I’ve run in the simulation. But am I sitting on a backlog bigger than everyone else's? Probably not. I prefer quality control over quantity. If it ain't broke, don't fix it, but I’m always willing to run a diagnostic on something new.

speaker: Beth
text: "32: I could be ■■■■■■■■ submissive now, and be ■■■■■■■■ dominant another time (either to the same, or to another partner)."

text: That’s a 7. Absolutely. I’m built to run the line, but sometimes you need to let the dispatcher take the tower. It’s all about who’s got the best view of the traffic. I can drive the bus or I can ride the rails, depending on the shift. Flexibility is just good redundancy planning.

speaker: Beth
text: "33: Living with a group of slaves owned by me and serving me, would be my ultimate life goal."

text: That’s a 1. One crew is enough work. I don’t want a harem; I want a partner. Managing a whole house full of people sounds like a logistics nightmare I’d never get a day off from. Give me one competent person who knows my coffee order over a dozen subordinates any day.

speaker: Beth
text: "34: It's no big deal when things I try turn out bad for me. It's part of the risk and it's a necessary part of discovering what works and what doesn't."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 7. Totally. You don't learn the route without taking a wrong turn now and then. If a coupling fails, you check the logs, you find the error, and you patch it. It’s not a failure, it’s data. I’d rather try and blow a fuse than sit in the depot wondering "what if".

text: "35: I enjoy keeping my partner as a pet: providing them with a cage, feeding them out of a bowl, petting/caressing them, etc."

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 2. I can appreciate a nice cozy setup and taking care of someone, don’t get me wrong. But the cage and the bowl? That feels like degrading the hardware. I want a partner who can stand up next to me, not something I keep in a kennel. I prefer my co-pilots walking on two legs.

speaker: Cora
text: That’s a 2. Look, if the route doesn't work, you fix the route, you don't go find another bus. I’d rather put in the effort to learn the gears or find a workaround together than start outsourcing the job. I’m in it for the long haul, not to hand off the difficult cargo to someone else.

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth
text: "60: I want my partner to serve me and address me as a superior."

speaker: Beth
text: "62: I enjoy being verbally degraded or being called humiliating names during ■■■/BDSM."

speaker: Beth

speaker: Beth
text: Well, that's all I have for you. I'll get your BDSM Test results back to you soon enough. Thanks again for your participation. I can't wait to see what you and the rest of the cast think about your results!
